About this home
Oversized, well-located, and set on a quiet dead-end street just moments from the beach. This 4-bedroom, 3-bath home offers the kind of space buyers want right now. The main level features an open entry foyer, a formal dining room, an eat-in kitchen, a den with fireplace, and a living room with cathedral ceilings. Additional highlights include an attached 2-car garage plus a large driveway, an expansive yard with outdoor kitchen, and a finished basement. Mother/daughter potential with a separate entrance. Coastal living at its finest!
